svg.title: Solar panel monitoring and predictive corrective control workflow
svg.desc: Current project workflow from simulated sensors through ESP32, local Wokwi serial bridge, dashboard estimates and simulated corrective actions, with optional Firebase storage.
svg.text: Solar Panel Monitoring and Predictive Corrective Control
Implemented workflow in the ESP32 + Wokwi + React dashboard project
Simulated sensor and control inputs
Photoresistor → irradiance · DHT22 → temperature · potentiometers → soiling and tilt
Read and refreshed about every 2 seconds in Wokwi
ESP32 firmware
Scales sensor values, maps soiling to a fault class, controls servo and indicator LEDs
Calculates modeled operating power and clean-reference expected power
Offline model training
Kaggle weather + inverter
records → Ridge regression
Shared coefficients exported
to ESP32 and browser code
Model predicts power; it does not classify faults.
Local Wokwi serial bridge
Wokwi RFC2217 serial → Vite bridge → local dashboard API and event stream
No MQTT or cloud transport is used for the live telemetry path
React dashboard
Shows environmental readings, soiling %, tilt angle, power estimates, status, chart and action history
Connection status follows telemetry freshness; Firebase status is separate
Compare expected power with modeled operating power
Expected = clean fault class at current irradiance · Operating = current fault class with temperature and tilt adjustments
Underperforming only when telemetry is fresh and deficit exceeds max(8 W, 10% of expected power)
Underperforming?
Based on modeled estimates
No
Nominal status
Continue displaying incoming telemetry
Yes
Evaluate candidate actions
Estimate recovery and subtract illustrative Wh costs
Simulated corrective actions
• Tilt: command servo toward 20°
• Cleaning: pulse LED and set simulated soiling to 0%
• Cooling: pulse LED and apply a 29°C software temperature cap
User applies a recommended action
Dashboard → local Vite bridge → serial command → ESP32/Wokwi
Fresh telemetry verifies simulated state
Dashboard compares predicted recovery with simulated before/after power change
Records action, timestamp and absolute error; no overall recovery percentage
Optional Firebase storage
After anonymous sign-in/configuration: save telemetry and completed action results
How to interpret the results
• Power values and candidate recovery are model estimates.
• Post-action changes are simulated telemetry, not meter readings.
• The project has no physical PV panel or voltage/current power meter.
• The dataset has no measured dust percentage or tilt angle.
• Soiling bands, 20° target and correction rules are demo assumptions.
The workflow demonstrates IoT acquisition, local telemetry, model-based
decision support, simulated control, and confirmation through new readings.
Simulation and educational prototype · No physical energy recovery is claimed
